responsibility: Performs LRA’s post-spill pseudo coalescing pass for spilled pseudos. It identifies profitable pseudo-to-pseudo moves that would otherwise become memory-memory moves, sorts them by execution frequency, merges nonconflicting pseudo groups by combining live ranges, substitutes group representatives throughout affected RTL and BB live bitmaps, deletes resulting no-op moves, and invalidates uniqueness information when merged values could alias. Its role is targeted cleanup of spill-induced copies before the next LRA constraint iteration.
